name: Avery Dennison
fiscalYearEnd: Saturday nearest December 31 (FY2025 ended December 31, 2025 per 10-K cover)

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (Avery Dennison logo red.svg)

description: Avery Dennison is mostly a materials-science company: it coats paper, film and foil with adhesive and sells the rolls of self-adhesive label material to label converters, who print the labels for food, beverage, home and personal care, and logistics. It also makes vehicle-wrap and reflective films, tapes, and a growing line of RFID tags and apparel branding and price-ticket solutions sold to retailers and apparel brands. Materials Group is 69% of 2025 sales ($6.1B of $8.9B) and Solutions Group 31%. Its sub-industry is 'packaging' in the standard scheme, but the business is label materials and RFID item-identification rather than boxes or containers.

businessLines.name: Materials Group
businessLines.how: Rolls of adhesive-coated material sold per square metre to label converters and sign shops, with pricing that follows raw-material (paper, film, adhesive) costs; ongoing, repeat orders from a converter network.
businessLines.description: Pressure-sensitive label materials, graphics and reflective products, and performance tapes and fasteners.

operatingProfit.note: segment adjusted operating income (excludes other expense/income and other items of $31.6M)

businessLines.name: Solutions Group
businessLines.how: Per-unit sales of tags, labels and RFID inlays to apparel brands, retailers and logistics firms, plus Vestcom shelf-label services to grocery and retail chains.
businessLines.description: Branding and information solutions: ultra-high-frequency RFID inlays and tags, brand embellishments, graphic tickets and labels, price ticketing, care and compliance labels, and Vestcom shelf-edge productivity and media solutions.

operatingProfit.note: segment adjusted operating income (excludes other expense/income and other items of $39.0M)
